title: rosa × dumetorum var. cinerosa
intro: Rosa × dumetorum var. cinerosa, commonly known as cineraria rose, is a type of rose plant that belongs to the Rosaceae family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and relieving respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma, due to its antitussive and expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Rosa × dumetorum var. cinerosa include its ability to calm the nervous system and provide relief from anxiety and stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
